hints.title: Complement Avoidance
hints.text: If x is chosen, k - x cannot be chosen. To minimize sum, choose the smaller of the two.

hints.title: First Partition
hints.text: Take integers starting from 1 up to k // 2. Let this count be m = min(n, k // 2).

hints.title: Second Partition
hints.text: If n > m, the remaining n - m numbers can safely start from k onward without conflicting with any earlier number.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def minimumSum(self, n: int, k: int) -> int:
        m = min(n, k // 2)
        rem = n - m
        sum1 = m * (m + 1) // 2
        sum2 = rem * k + rem * (rem - 1) // 2
        return sum1 + sum2
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating number-by-number set addition takes O(n) when direct formulas evaluate in O(1).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Split into two arithmetic series partitions for constant-time evaluation.
